name: Valley Fresh Cannery & Paste
intake_notes: Receiving dock B is running day shift only today until 18:00 due to planned boiler maintenance. Accepts processing grade or ripe Roma with minor softness, but strictly refuses any lots with visible rot or fungal decay exceeding 2%. Electric pallet jacks and forklift on site. Driver must sign QA weight ticket.

name: Hope Community Food Rescue
intake_notes: Urgent need for fresh produce. Can accept drop-off within 2 hours. Tomatoes must be edible fresh table grade or mild softness for same-day evening family box distribution. Cold holding capacity is limited to 5 metric tons; volunteer sorting crew on duty 13:00 to 17:00 only. Tax deductible donation receipt issued immediately upon check-in.

name: Metro Wholesale Produce Terminal
intake_notes: Dock 4 receiving is open 24/7. High price offered, BUT reefer transport temperature log required on arrival. Terminal inspector will immediately reject the load if tomato core temperature exceeds 15.5C or if firm-ripe status has degraded to soft/overripe. Deducts a flat $150.00 pallet unloading fee from net payout.

name: SunCoast Dehydrators & Sun-Dried Co.
intake_notes: Intake bay open until 20:00. Specifically seeks high-solids Roma tomatoes for drying lines. Tolerates minor skin cracks, light bruising, and ripe red fruit provided fruit is processed within 6 hours. Fast turn-around unloading.
